question: On the exact current correlated K times Lambda strip, does the selected actual projective kappa sensitivity h=partial_kappa rho have a uniform strictly negative one-sided bound at Q0=-4, using the hash-pinned Qswitch seed and Q0 endpoint chart only?
primary_sources: Selection context inherited through the pinned upstream results: NIST DLMF section 2.7(iii), Liouville-Green approximation for the selected real plus-recessive family: https://dlmf.nist.gov/2.7#iii

declared_conventions.Q0_amplitude_bound_provenance: 0<U(Q0)<7 from the hash-pinned full-corridor outward chart
declared_conventions.primary_source_scope: The DLMF entry identifies the upstream selected-family context; this calculation's new step is the displayed exact Wronskian algebra over hash-pinned repository evidence and reuses no local method-source implementation.
declared_conventions.derivative_scope: two-sided partial_kappa derivative in the corridor interior and the corresponding one-sided derivative at each kappa face, at fixed lambda
declared_conventions.execution: exact SymPy identities and rational inequalities over two hash-pinned upstream results; no Bessel evaluation, ODE integration, quadrature, root solve, finite difference, sampling, panel, compact Taylor transfer or bisection

upstream_results.role: pins the exact strip, selected-family linkage, finite-IVP derivative seed and exact analytic p_switch>kappa_left/20 floor
pins the same selected switch-normalized actual family, validated finite linear transfer and full-corridor nonzero U(Q0) endpoint chart; its Gamma face signs are not kappa-derivative evidence

assumptions: The Qswitch result supplies the existing fixed-lambda derivative seed and exact positive floor without imposing a new singular-endpoint C1 condition.
Standard smooth parameter dependence for the regular finite linear IVP propagates U and Y from Qswitch to Q0.
The sign-strip result supplies the same switch-normalized selected actual direction and a full-corridor outward Q0 amplitude interval strictly inside (0,7).

Possible intermediate zeros of U do not obstruct the regular linear U,Y,W evolution or this endpoint-only argument. Only U(Q0) is divided by; no pole-free projective chart on every interior Q is claimed.
The Wronskian identity supplies a one-sided sign margin only. It does not compute a two-sided numerical h(Q0) enclosure or any differentiated boundary functional.
